classification: Actual native Godot mage battle fixtures using finite normal acquisition/merge APIs, player persistence disabled. VFX masks authored in project code; no new generated source atlas.

profiles.baseline: 1440x960 normal legal fire/water/wind acquisition and weaving; published four phases of each source and result; derived report.
profiles.1280x800: Same legal fixture at the smaller native window; three selected spell frames; derived report.
profiles.1920x1080: Same legal fixture at the larger native window; three selected spell frames; derived report.
profiles.before_ribbon_fix: Intermediate actual flight frame with dotted diamond trail, preceding continuous ribbon and ground-layer clipping fix; not final UI.
